Frontend bundle split into vendor (React/lodash) and app chunks

Moved authentication from middleware to decorator pattern for granular control
Adopted Pydantic v2 for all API request/response validation
Selected Vite over webpack for frontend build tooling (10x faster HMR)
Went with server-sent events over polling for real-time notifications
Chose PostgreSQL JSONB for dynamic config instead of separate config service
Adopted trunk-based development with short-lived feature branches
Selected pytest over unittest for better fixture composition
Moved from monolith to 3 services: api-gateway, auth-service, data-pipeline
Chose Redis Streams over Kafka for event bus (simpler ops, sufficient throughput)

Prefetching next page data during scroll reduces perceived load time

Feature flag checks at the component level avoid unnecessary API calls
Splitting large Celery tasks into subtasks improved worker utilization 40%
Using dataclasses for internal DTOs reduced memory footprint by 25%
Index-only scans on the events table sped up dashboard queries 8x

Celery beat schedule timezone is UTC, not local time as configured

guides.api-patterns:
# API Design Patterns

Standard patterns used across all services.

## Authentication

All endpoints require JWT bearer token. Token rotation handled by auth-service.

## Error Format

All errors follow RFC 7807 Problem Details format:
```json
{"type": "about:blank", "title": "Not Found", "status": 404, "detail": "User 123 not found"}
```

## Pagination

Cursor-based pagination via `?cursor=<opaque>&limit=50`. Never use offset pagination.

## Rate Limiting

Sliding window algorithm. Headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset.
guides.testing-strategy:
# Testing Strategy

Pyramid model: many unit tests, fewer integration, minimal E2E.

## Unit Tests

Pytest with fixtures. Mock external services. Target: 80% coverage.

## Integration Tests

Testcontainers for PostgreSQL and Redis. Real database, real cache.

## E2E Tests

Playwright for frontend flows. Run nightly, not on every PR.

## Performance Tests

Locust for load testing. Run before major releases against staging.
